senses.gloss: c. (σαλαμάνδρα) salamander, a reptile believed to be engendered in fire.

VI, Par. 5; <cite ref="Chullin 127a:9">Ḥull. 127ᵃ</cite> (classified under <cite ref="R00015"><he>צָב</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Chagigah 27a:7">Ḥag. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>ס׳ … הסך מדמה וכ׳</he> he who oints himself with the blood of the salamander becomes fire-proof; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 373:1">Yalk. Ex. 373</cite>; Tanḥ. Vayesheb 3.
